notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are governmental funds here), no business-type funds, so business_type null. Receipts, disbursements, transfers and balances come from the Statement of Modified Cash Basis Assets and Fund Balances and Receipts, Disbursements and Changes (Exhibit III, pp8-15), Total Governmental Funds column (pp9, 11, 13). Transfers 265,054.09 = General 265,000 (to School Nutrition 150,000 and Activities 115,000) + Student Fee 54.09 to General; printed on pp9 and 13 outside receipts/disbursements totals. Balance sheet from Exhibit I (p1); liabilities printed as 0.00 so one zero line is recorded. Exhibit II (Statement of Activities, pp2-7) not used for amounts. Local Receipts is a combined line across funds; its tax breakdown is only shown per fund (General p17 includes interest of 58,042.37 that the fund statement shows as investment income), so it is not split. Non-Revenue Receipts 308,613.07 in the fund statement includes Depreciation Fund 'Allocation from General Fund' 300,000 (Sch C p21), and General Fund 'Property' 100,000 (2650) and 200,000 (2710) look like the matching spending; left as printed, flagged for review. Detail: General Fund receipts from Sch A (pp17-18); General Fund spending from Sch M (operational expenses by program and object, pp28-38), which is more detailed than Sch B (pp19-20, program totals only), so Sch B and Sch A-1 (p16) were not recorded to avoid double counting. Sch M 8000 Transfers recorded as other financing (-150,000 and -115,000) inside the printed 5,959,371.64 total. Sch A 5200 transfer 54.09 and Sch C allocation 300,000, Sch F 115,000, Sch G 150,000 transfers recorded as other financing within printed receipt totals (includes other financing); Sch L (Student Fee) transfer -54.09 recorded as other financing, no totals printed. Sch D has no totals printed. Sch M zero-amount lines and blank-actual lines (budget only) were skipped; budget columns printed only on the last line of Sch F disbursements, Sch I disbursements and Sch C total are left null except Sch C 2900-700 (1,081,007 printed on that line). Object mapping used for Sch M: Other Property Services -> professional/contract services (except 2610 -> utilities, review), Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance, Other Items -> dues, training and travel. Identity check: 4,682,144.96 + 6,725,419.38 - 6,495,626.91 + 265,054.09 - 265,054.09 = 4,911,937.43. Read pages 1-38 of 38.
